groups.sentence: Universities are exploring, piloting or expanding AI services and tools on campus, including AI tutoring add-ons.
Faculty and staff may build custom AI tutors, chatbots or assistants for students in the university's AI platform.
Instructors define and provide access to approved AI tools students may use, and encourage recommended university-approved tools.
University IT maintains, expands and promotes secure enterprise-level AI tools and platforms for the campus.
Students may use university-provided AI tools in coursework when permitted, and are encouraged to use them for research and writing.
Course-specific AI tools guide students through research questions, citation and writing feedback during their work.
Instructors invite students to use custom course AI chatbots during their coursework.
The university provides approved, licensed generative AI tools with data protections to students, faculty and staff through university accounts.
